question: Which sacred rivers are invoked to establish their presence in the water at hand?
premises: The rivers Narmada, Sindhu, and Kaveri are directly addressed.
A request is made concerning this water.
The request asks for the establishment of presence in this water.
inference: The invoked rivers are asked to make their presence manifest in the water at hand.
plain_english: O Narmada, O Sindhu, O Kaveri, make your presence in this water.
